# HELP scylla_manager_repair_task_properties Configured properties of a repair task, always 1. Join it to the other task metrics on the "task" label. The name and the schedule of the task are reported by "scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties". A property that was not configured and has no Scylla Manager side default is reported as "-" - the incremental mode is one, because Scylla Manager leaves it to Scylla. The "keyspace", "dc" and "host" labels are the configured filters, not what the run resolved them to - a keyspace matched by the filter can still be left out, for example because of its replication.
# TYPE scylla_manager_repair_task_properties gauge
scylla_manager_repair_task_properties{cluster="b703df56-c428-46a7-bfba-cfa6ee91b976",dc="all",fail_fast="false",host="all",ignore_down_hosts="-",incremental_mode="-",keyspace="*,!system_traces",keyspace_replication="all",task="965f4f5c-c7d1-4ae6-b770-a2225df4ef49"} 1
